name: flask-jwt-notes-api
title: Scribble API - Flask JSON notes API with Bearer JWT
description: A JSON REST API for personal notes secured with stateless Bearer JWTs (15-minute access + 7-day refresh tokens, HS256) and a role claim for admin endpoints, with an embedded Swagger UI reading a hand-written OpenAPI 3.1 spec.

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.description: HS256 signing secret for access and refresh tokens. Set a long random value in production.

env.name: SECRET_KEY
env.description: Flask SECRET_KEY (not used for JWTs; kept for Flask internals).

env.name: DATABASE_PATH
env.description: SQLite file path; absolute or relative to the project root (parent dir auto-created). Docker image sets /app/data/scribble.db.

env.name: AUTO_SEED
env.description: Seed demo users/notes at startup when the users table is empty.

env.name: CORS_ORIGINS
env.description: Allowed CORS origins ('*' or comma-separated list).

auth.description: POST /auth/login (JSON email+password) returns access_token (15 min) and refresh_token (7 days). Send 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>' on protected routes; POST /auth/refresh with the refresh token to renew. Admin routes require the JWT claim role=admin (403 otherwise). No cookies, no sessions.

persistence: SQLite file at data/scribble.db (DATABASE_PATH); Docker image stores it at /app/data (declared VOLUME). Tables are created and demo data seeded automatically on first start (create_app), or explicitly with `flask --app app seed`.
notes: Single container, no external services. Startup is safe with multiple gunicorn workers (concurrent create_all/seed is tolerated). The docs page loads swagger-ui-dist from cdn.jsdelivr.net at browser time; the API itself has no runtime network dependency. GET / redirects (302) to /docs. Mount a writable volume at /app/data to keep data across restarts.
